about: Faces made by an image model (tools/showcase/make-faces.mjs) to check the skin check, the shade finder and Roja Clinic's procedures against: no real person. Each face says what it was asked to show (fitz: the Fitzpatrick type asked for; skin: the condition asked for), so the measurements can be compared with it. Not shown on the site. Made by .github/workflows/calibrate.yml into a branch of their own.
style: Photorealistic studio portrait photograph of one adult, head and upper shoulders, facing the camera straight on, eyes open looking into the lens, mouth closed, relaxed neutral expression, hair pulled back away from the face so the whole face and jawline show, no glasses, no jewellery, no makeup, bare natural skin with real texture and pores, soft even daylight from the front, white balanced, plain light grey background, sharp focus, 85mm lens. The person is fictional.
